lessons.cause: Flatpak replaces XDG_CONFIG_HOME passed by --env; the packaged BlastEm patch treats that directory directly as its config directory.
lessons.change: Set XDG_CONFIG_HOME inside the sandbox shell to the project directory containing blastem.cfg; preserve the complete packaged default configuration before adding P2 bindings.

lessons.cause: A failed selection leaves both health sampling areas black; zero yellow alone falsely suggests KO. PAL also changes the vertical framing of the NTSC name template.
lessons.change: Require visible fight HUD before the attack script. Cover the complete upper HUD band for PAL/NTSC sampling. Always review winner text and fighter state; do not approve by sample count.

lessons.cause: ROM copies all called rom.bin otherwise reuse the same global SRAM directory; desktop audio includes unrelated applications.
lessons.change: Use session-local XDG_DATA_HOME; optional dedicated null sink with explicit PULSE_SINK, monitor capture and own-stream metadata. Unload only that temporary sink at exit.
lessons.claim_limit: Audio capture is not an artistic/listening approval; recording cadence is not ROM loop FPS.

lessons.cause: Host audio policy sent the BlastEm stream to the DSP sink despite PULSE_SINK; the requested isolated monitor was empty and its WAV silent.
lessons.change: Identify exactly one newly created blastem.bin sink-input, move only that stream to the session sink and verify actual assignment before capture.
lessons.claim_limit: PAL gameplay evidence remains usable; its silent audio is not a passing audio test.
